sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: graduated licensing, license classes and renewal
Knowledge facts: part C holds 37 fact blocks (sec03-F01 onward) from physical pages 16 to 24; part C2 holds 23 confusable and continuation blocks (sec03-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer (physical page 3), the June 2026 edition (physical page 1), the written test format, the 80 percent passing score, the one-test-per-day rule, the retest fee and the vision minimums from physical page 13; the question count and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- MN-GDL-A-COUNT — written test question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- MN-GDL-A-TIME — written test time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- MN-GDL-D-CHAPTER — the adult permit paragraph cites a Chapter 9 that the manual does not contain (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- MN-GDL-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- MN-GDL-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the reinstatement fee, the upgrade credit and the fast-track fee (for example sec03-F26, sec03-F31, sec03-R23) are set by the Legislature or DVS and must be refreshed from the DVS fee page.

corpus_stability.reason: The Minnesota Driver’s Manual prints a single edition line (June 2026) on its front cover and opens with a New laws and information chapter that collects recent changes in one place, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.
